item.title: No IPO, no apologies: Kuba Jewgieniew on building a global brand without going corporate
item.description: Founder Kuba Jewgieniew credits culture and innovation for Realty ONE Group’s 20-year success and global reach

item.title: FHFA sets 2026-2028 housing goals for GSEs
item.description: The FHFA has issued new housing goals for the GSEs, lowering benchmarks for single-family and multifamily mortgages for 2026-2028.

item.title: Opinion: Easing GSE credit score requirements raises risk concerns
item.description: Removing minimum credit score requirements could increase risk for GSEs as new models and scores are adopted, raising concerns for investors.

item.title: reAlpha to buy InstaMortgage for $8.5M to expand direct lending
item.description: Real estate technology company reAlpha Tech Corp. has closed a deal to acquire lender InstaMortgage Inc. for $8.5 million in a cash-and-stock transaction.

item.title: How The Loan Store doubled volume in a crowded wholesale market
item.description: In the first nine months of 2025, the company doubled its origination volume to $8.2 billion, ranking as the fourth-largest U.S. wholesale lender.

item.title: November sees sharp rise in U.S. mortgage delinquencies
item.description: U.S. mortgage delinquencies surged in November, reaching their highest level in over four years, primarily due to calendar effects.

item.title: MBA 2026 forecast: Slow growth amid inflation, rate hikes
item.description: MBA’s December forecast projects economic growth of 1.6% in 2025 and puts the chance of a recession over the next 12 months at 35%.

item.title: Mortgage rates cool in 2025, but 2026 relief likely limited
item.description: Mortgage rates started the year slightly above 7% but are heading into the holiday season near 6.2%. 2026 forecasts show little change ahead.

item.title: Texas proposes property tax cuts for homeowners 55+
item.description: Texas Lt. Gov. Dan Patrick's "Operation Double Nickel" proposes lowering the senior property tax benefit age to 55 and expanding exemptions.

item.title: Mortgage applications fall 5% despite rate decline
item.description: Despite steady mortgage rates, market trends like a softening job market and elevated inventories continue to impact application volumes.
